subject: Foundry Labs accelerator: convert promo credits into Dedicated discount addendum
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@foundrylabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo credit question — convert to Dedicated discount?

Sean —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Foundry Labs is excited about Redwood and we want to make the accelerator benefit as useful as possible for our cohort. Right now your program offers $25k in promo credits for startups. Several of our fastest-moving teams prefer committed capacity (Dedicated) rather than managing a series of pay-as-you-go invoices.

Two asks:
- Is there precedent for converting promo credits into a committed capacity discount (e.g., apply credits as a one-time offset against first 3 months of a dedicated commitment)?
- If yes, what packaging/contract language do you need from us and what operational steps are required (billing, invoice offsets, account mapping)?

We want to offer this as an option to a handful of teams but need to present a clean path to our legal/finance folks. Attached is our accelerator one-pager for context.

Appreciate any quick guidance — happy to jump on a short call.

Best,
Emma Li
Program Director, Foundry Labs
emma@foundrylabs.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: Foundry_Accelerator_OnePager.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@foundrylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credit question — convert to Dedicated discount?

Emma —

Really appreciate the context and the one-pager. Short answer: yes, we can make that work but it needs a small addendum and some ops steps on the account side. High level proposal:

1) Convert $25k promo credits into a 3-month offset against a minimum 6-month Dedicated reserve (applied as an invoice credit over first 3 monthly bill runs).
2) Offer an additional 10% marketing discount on top of the reserve price if Foundry propagates a cohort referral (mutual action).
3) We require a Customer Addendum that maps the accelerator cohort to the customer account(s) and lists eligible team accounts by email.

Operational notes: billing will need an invoice credit (we'll create a one-time credit memos run), and provisioning will need the Dedicated seat IDs to pin the reserved pool. For legal: we can do a short addendum (one page) instead of modifying the main TOS.

I attached a draft addendum (Draft_Addendum_v1.docx) with the mechanics. Marissa/Ben — can you review pricing carveouts and confirm the discount stacks? If legal is comfortable we can route to Foundry's counsel.

If it helps, I'm available for a 20-min sync tomorrow at 10am PT.

Thanks —
Sean
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0133

Attachment: Draft_Addendum_v1.docx
From: Foundry Labs Legal <legal@foundrylabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credit question — convert to Dedicated discount?

Sean —

Thanks for the quick reply and draft. A couple of points from our side before we proceed to signature:

1) Data handling: we need explicit language about which account(s) the Dedicated capacity will be bound to and confirmation that cohort teams retain separate data segregation (no cross-account pooling).
2) Audit logs & retention: our finance team wants to ensure credit application is auditable — request a clause that references invoice credit memos and a timeline for when credits appear on statements.
3) Termination: if a cohort team fails to onboard to Dedicated in 30 days, can credits be reallocated back to Foundry central account? We prefer a 60-day reallocation window.

I attached a redline (Foundry_Redline_v1.docx) but flagged that the above items are key. Happy to mark up the addendum directly if you prefer.

Regards,
Foundry Labs Legal
legal@foundrylabs.com

Attachment: Foundry_Redline_v1.docx
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Foundry Labs Legal <legal@foundrylabs.com>, Emma Li <emma@foundrylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credit question — convert to Dedicated discount?

Emma / Legal team —

Thanks for the redline and the clear asks. Looping in Irene from Legal and Marissa on packaging. Below are proposed edits (high-level) that should resolve Foundry's concerns:

- Account binding & segregation: add paragraph A.2 in the addendum stating each cohort team must create a distinct Redwood account and we will map promo credits to the account IDs listed on the Addendum schedule; Dedicated pools will not share KV/tenant data across accounts. (Irene: is the wording below operationally sufficient?)
- Auditability: we will generate an invoice credit memo for each credit application and provide a PDF statement within 5 business days after credit issuance. Addendum to reference credit memo ID and Redwood billing portal link for audit.
- Reallocation window: propose a 45-day onboarding window (compromise). Credits revert to Foundry central account if an eligible team fails to accept provisioning within 45 days; exceptions can be requested via support escalation.

Marissa — pricing confirmation: converting $25k into a 3-month invoice offset against a 6-month Dedicated reserve plus 10% referral marketing discount — are we comfortable with margin and precedent? Ben — ops feasibility on credit memos and account mapping?

If everyone is aligned I'll push a v2 of the addendum with these edits and we can route to Foundry for a single signature.

On call availability: next week Tue/Wed mornings PT for final sign-off.

Cheers,
Sean
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
